mentions.name: Abejora
mentions.description: Time tracking tool for freelancers and small teams. It adds access for AI agents so users' own agents can handle the repetitive parts of time tracking, with the core rebuilt to support change history and full undo/redo so control stays with the user. Runs on Elixir and Phoenix LiveView in a Kubernetes cluster of Talos instances.
mentions.problem: The timesheet tool the team paid for raised its prices and moved regularly used features behind more expensive plans; with three new colleagues added, it would have cost $500 a year more for the same software.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.abejora.com - time tracking for freelancers and small teams

Lately we've been working on access for AI agents. A lot of people want their own agent to do the repetitive part of time tracking. Control remains important, which is why we rebuilt our core this month to support change history and full undo/redo functionality. Feel free to try it with your own agent.
